get.summary: List owned links in one domain or, with domains/-, across all domains.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description:
Format: domains/{domain}, or domains/- for all domains. Only links owned
by the caller are returned. The result is strongly consistent with writes.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description:
Maximum number to return. The service chooses a sensible default when
zero; it may cap larger values. Negative values are invalid.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Token from a previous response; all other parameters must match.

200.description: Links owned by the caller in the requested domain scope.

post.summary:
Atomically claim an explicit path or generate an unused suffix. Generated
collisions are retried; no existing link is overwritten.
Writes complete synchronously and return the resource directly.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description:
The canonical domain parent. Format: domains/{domain}. Any syntactically
valid domain is accepted; explicit ports are invalid. Domains are
normalized to lowercase. Domain creation policy belongs to authorization.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description:
Optional idempotency key, at most 36 ASCII characters; UUIDs are accepted.
Successful results are retained for 24 hours, scoped to caller and request.
Reusing an ID for a different request is invalid. A lost-response retry
returns the original result, including for generated paths.
Non-UUID request IDs are valid, so UUID4 format is not required.

parameters.name: validateOnly
parameters.description:
Check permissions, validity and conflicts without claiming an address or
recording request_id. The response is the proposed ShortLink.

200.description:
A managed HTTP redirect at one source domain and path.

The identity is (canonical domain, canonical path), regardless of whether a
source request uses HTTP or HTTPS. Writes take effect synchronously; after a
successful write, management reads and HTTP redirects observe the result.
No delete_time or display_name is exposed: links are hard-deleted and path
is their readable identity. (AIP-148 exception.)

The synchronous resource has no in-flight reconciliation state.

encoded_path names the reversible path encoding rather than an arbitrary ID.

delete.summary:
Delete an owned link. On success reads and redirects see its absence.
Writes complete synchronously and return Empty directly.

parameters.name: etag
parameters.description:
If present, must match the current ETag; a mismatch returns ABORTED.
Ignored when the link is absent and allow_missing is true.

parameters.name: allowMissing
parameters.description:
Succeed without a write if the link is absent. Existing links still
require owner permission. A deleted address is immediately reusable.

parameters.name: validateOnly
parameters.description: Perform the normal checks without deleting the link.

patch.summary:
Apply mutable fields. On success reads and redirects see the new state.
Writes complete synchronously and return the resource directly.

parameters.name: short_link.name
parameters.description:
The resource name. Format: domains/{domain}/shortLinks/{encoded_path}.
The server derives encoded_path as "p" followed by unpadded RFC 4648
Base32 of the UTF-8 bytes of the canonical path, in lowercase. Decoding
after the prefix is reversible. For example, "/" becomes "pf4".
This path-derived name deliberately has no independent short_link_id
request field (an exception to AIP-133). On create, name is ignored.

parameters.name: updateMask
parameters.description:
Fields to change. Allowed paths are destination_url and annotations.
An omitted mask updates populated mutable fields. "*" replaces both
mutable fields; an explicitly masked empty value clears annotations.

x40.link.v1alpha.ShortLink.description:
A managed HTTP redirect at one source domain and path.

The identity is (canonical domain, canonical path), regardless of whether a
source request uses HTTP or HTTPS. Writes take effect synchronously; after a
successful write, management reads and HTTP redirects observe the result.
No delete_time or display_name is exposed: links are hard-deleted and path
is their readable identity. (AIP-148 exception.)

The synchronous resource has no in-flight reconciliation state.

encoded_path names the reversible path encoding rather than an arbitrary ID.

annotations.description:
User-managed metadata. A mask containing "annotations" replaces the map;
an empty map clears it.

destinationUrl.description: An absolute HTTP or HTTPS destination URL. Required on create.

etag.description:
An opaque, quoted, server-computed strong ETag. It changes when mutable
state changes and cannot match the ETag of a previous incarnation at the
same name. If supplied on update, it is a precondition, not a change.

name.description:
The resource name. Format: domains/{domain}/shortLinks/{encoded_path}.
The server derives encoded_path as "p" followed by unpadded RFC 4648
Base32 of the UTF-8 bytes of the canonical path, in lowercase. Decoding
after the prefix is reversible. For example, "/" becomes "pf4".
This path-derived name deliberately has no independent short_link_id
request field (an exception to AIP-133). On create, name is ignored.

path.description:
The source path, starting with "/". Path identity follows URI rules:
case, literal "+", repeated slashes, and escaped reserved characters
remain distinct. Percent escapes use uppercase hex in canonical form;
escapes for unreserved characters are decoded. A source query is ignored
and is never appended to destination_url. On create, omission requests a
generated suffix; an explicit "/" claims the root path. On update, the
path is immutable and, if supplied, must match name.

shortUrl.description: The canonical HTTPS source URL, computed by the server.

uid.description:
The server-assigned identity of this incarnation. Deleting and recreating
the same name produces a new uid.
The UID format remains opaque while the service migration is pending.

updateTime.description: When the mutable state last changed. An identical update leaves it alone.

tags.name: ShortLinkService
tags.description:
Authenticated management of short links. The public HTTP redirect remains
outside this service and continues to use status 307.
